# References · The canon

> Twelve works that every roboticist should know: one path from 1955 to today. Each Mark's folder has its own, deeper list.

12 works · difficulty: ★☆☆ accessible · ★★☆ technical · ★★★ research-grade  
Read with the [three-pass method](../docs/papers.md#how-to-read-a-paper). Every link is a Google Scholar search for the exact title. [Master index →](../docs/papers.md)

## The canon, in chronological order

#### ★★☆ A kinematic notation for lower-pair mechanisms based on matrices

Denavit & Hartenberg · 1955 · *Journal of Applied Mechanics* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20kinematic%20notation%20for%20lower-pair%20mechanisms%20based%20on%20matrices%22)

- **Why:** The notation that described robot arms for 60 years (Mark VI).
- **Read:** The notation section.

#### ★★★ A new approach to linear filtering and prediction problems

Rudolf Kalman · 1960 · *Journal of Basic Engineering* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20new%20approach%20to%20linear%20filtering%20and%20prediction%20problems%22)

- **Why:** The filter behind every navigation system since Apollo (Mark VII).
- **Read:** Read it after Mark VII's KF, and compare the notation.

#### ★★☆ A formal basis for the heuristic determination of minimum cost paths

Hart, Nilsson & Raphael · 1968 · *IEEE Transactions on Systems Science and Cybernetics* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20formal%20basis%20for%20the%20heuristic%20determination%20of%20minimum%20cost%20paths%22)

- **Why:** A*: optimal search with heuristics (Mark VII).
- **Read:** The algorithm and the admissibility proof.

#### ★★★ On-line computational scheme for mechanical manipulators

Luh, Walker & Paul · 1980 · *Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22On-line%20computational%20scheme%20for%20mechanical%20manipulators%22)

- **Why:** O(n) inverse dynamics: the birth of RNEA (Mark XI).
- **Read:** The recursive formulation.

#### ★★★ A unified approach for motion and force control of robot manipulators: The operational space formulation

Oussama Khatib · 1987 · *IEEE Journal on Robotics and Automation* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20unified%20approach%20for%20motion%20and%20force%20control%20of%20robot%20manipulators%3A%20The%20operational%20space%20formulation%22)

- **Why:** Operational-space control: controlling what the hand does, not the joints (Marks VI, XII).
- **Read:** Sections 1–3.

#### ★★☆ Intelligence without representation

Rodney Brooks · 1991 · *Artificial Intelligence* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Intelligence%20without%20representation%22)

- **Why:** The behaviour-based challenge to classical AI.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★☆ Probabilistic Robotics

Thrun, Burgard & Fox · 2005 · *MIT Press* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Probabilistic%20Robotics%22)

- **Why:** The probabilistic turn in robotics, as a textbook (Mark VII).
- **Read:** Chapters 2–4.

#### ★★★ Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms

Roy Featherstone · 2008 · *Springer* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Rigid%20Body%20Dynamics%20Algorithms%22)

- **Why:** The definitive rigid-body dynamics algorithms (Mark XI).
- **Read:** Chapters 2 and 5–7.

#### ★★☆ MuJoCo: A physics engine for model-based control

Todorov, Erez & Tassa · 2012 · *IROS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22MuJoCo%3A%20A%20physics%20engine%20for%20model-based%20control%22)

- **Why:** MuJoCo: the simulator that made model-based and learned control practical (Marks VI, XI–XIII).
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★★ Dynamic locomotion in the MIT Cheetah 3 through convex model-predictive control

Di Carlo et al. · 2018 · *IROS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Dynamic%20locomotion%20in%20the%20MIT%20Cheetah%203%20through%20convex%20model-predictive%20control%22)

- **Why:** Convex MPC that made quadrupeds dynamic (Mark XII).
- **Read:** Sections II–IV.

#### ★★★ Learning agile and dynamic motor skills for legged robots

Hwangbo et al. · 2019 · *Science Robotics* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Learning%20agile%20and%20dynamic%20motor%20skills%20for%20legged%20robots%22)

- **Why:** RL + actuator networks that got learned locomotion onto real hardware (Mark XIII).
- **Read:** The main text and the methods.

#### ★★★ Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor policy learning via action diffusion

Chi et al. · 2023 · *RSS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Diffusion%20Policy%3A%20Visuomotor%20policy%20learning%20via%20action%20diffusion%22)

- **Why:** Diffusion policies: generative models become robot controllers (Marks X, XIII).
- **Read:** Sections 1–4.
